courses.name: AP Police Constable (PET + Written)
courses.description: Ground training for the 100m, 800m/1600m run, long jump and shot put, plus daily written-exam classes for Arithmetic, Reasoning and General Studies.

courses.name: AP Police SI (PET + Written)
courses.description: Intensive SI preparation covering physical measurement standards, all PET events and the full Paper I & II written syllabus.

courses.name: Indian Army GD / Agniveer
courses.description: 1.6 km timed run, pull-ups, 9-feet ditch and zig-zag balance practice with CEE written coaching.

courses.name: SSC GD Constable
courses.description: Running endurance training and complete SSC GD written preparation.

courses.name: Railway RPF / RRB
courses.description: PET and CBT coaching for RPF constable and RRB group posts.

courses.name: General Fitness & Athletics
courses.description: Strength, endurance and athletics training for school and college students.
